responsibility: This larger tutorial example implements the toy stack-based virtual machine using the C++ libgccjit wrappers. It parses .toy scripts into C++ toyvm classes, interprets the opcode stream, lowers the VM operations into gccjit::context/functions/blocks/rvalues, compiles them to native code, and checks compiled results against the interpreter. It is the C++ binding demonstration of lowering a simple virtual-machine IR into libgccjit-generated machine code.
same_name_distinction: Unlike gcc/jit/docs/examples/tut04-toyvm/toyvm.c, this same-stem toy VM implementation is the C++ version: it wraps the VM in classes and lowers bytecode using gccjit C++ wrapper objects and methods.
